g.text: The set (P5a): a receive takes a class, and a send retires a class
r ← the first record in the pick order of the receive
a record r was found and the guard admits it?
then RESTORE-SCAN sends r again (Rule E)
C ← every stored member of the class of r, in DR-75 order,
one consume over [D] with the first member of C, which the
outcome dispatches, and one K_retire COMM over [D] for each
park the receive (the guard is checked once)
W ← the first waiter in the pick order of the send
whose pattern binds the datum x and whose guard admits it
RETIRE-CLASS: one single-channel K_retire COMM for each
stored non-persistent member of the class of x
a choice of the plan, in the pick order of the operation
the retire of the other members of a class
a stored record or a parked waiter
